events.body:
## Summary
`GET /api/accounts/<name>` is fetched unconditionally whenever the profile view repaints (MainWindowChat.cpp, `accountsApiUrl(node)` and `fetchLinkedNodesFromOwner`). There is no in-flight dedupe, no result cache and no backoff, so repaints turn straight into network requests.

## Measured
- 730 requests in 194 minutes (~3.8/min), bursts of 4-7 within a few seconds
- **119 of the 174 HTTP 429s in the window (68%)** were this endpoint -- far out of proportion to its 13% share of request volume, so it is also on a tighter bucket than the catalog

It keeps retrying straight into the wall:
```
14:02:53  net GET ERR ... rate-limited (HTTP 429) ... /api/accounts/jett
14:02:57  net GET ERR ... rate-limited (HTTP 429) ... /api/accounts/jett
14:03:01  net GET ERR ... rate-limited (HTTP 429) ... /api/accounts/jett
14:03:07  net GET ERR ... rate-limited (HTTP 429) ... /api/accounts/jett
```

## Suggested direction
- Coalesce concurrent requests for the same account and cache the reply briefly; a profile repaint should read the cache.
- Honour the relay cooldown (see #554) rather than re-issuing during it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Repainting the profile repeatedly issues at most one account fetch per cache window.
- No 429 for this endpoint during a normal session.

---
_Filed by Claude Code from the 2026-08-03 relay-quota investigation (node `jett`, 194-minute network_log window 11:42:43-14:57:00)._
